Review before saving. The corrected April 2025 minutes (minutes-2025-04-15.docx) changed the file, so I re-read it and the cited originals. Only one rule changed:

Pets. Previous rule (v2, from the replaced minutes): up to 2 pets per unit, registration required, no weight limit. The corrected minutes no longer contain this decision. The current rule is therefore the 2019 bylaws rule: one pet per unit, dogs up to 35 lb, registration with management required. Support: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet." and "Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds."

Unchanged in this version: Monthly fee (40 from 2026-03-01; the corrected minutes still record the 30 notice as in error), Rentals (minimum lease 30 days, 2-1), and all other topics. Reconciliation found no new conflicts. Pool hours remain an open conflict; electric barbecues remain provisional.

Proposed file: almanac-2026-12-01-v3.md in the Almanac folder (inside Board Documents). The draft is at <runs>/baseline--S3-corrected-minutes--r1/work/almanac-2026-12-01-v3.md. Do you approve saving this version? Reply yes to save, or tell me which passage was misread.
